text: When copying/adapting upstream pi example extensions into this repo, include README attribution with a link back to the original upstream example, following the existing notify README pattern.

For a future agent-workflow-audit extension, the user wants the distilled final audit results returned to the main session. The isolation goal is to keep intermediate discovery, command runs, raw errors, retries, and tool transcript out of the main session context, not to hide the final report.

The gnosis pi extension is intentionally agent-facing only: it exposes a gnosis tool but does not add user slash commands because the user explicitly said commands were unnecessary. Keep future UX changes aligned with that unless requested.

The unified Fast extension should be added without deleting or replacing the existing openai-fast and claude-fast standalone packages. The root @diegopetrucci/pi-extensions bundle should auto-load only the unified extension; the two provider-specific Fast extensions remain available as standalone packages but become standalone-only.
author: Diego Petrucci <baulei@icloud.com>
